from pathlib import Path
import re
path = Path('/tmp/sysgrid-chg57-r21.patch')
lines = path.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
result = []
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    if line.startswith('@@ '):
        match = re.match(r'@@ -(\\d+)(?:,\\d+)? \\+(\\d+)(?:,\\d+)? @@(.*)', line.rstrip('\\n'))
        if not match:
            raise SystemExit(f'bad hunk header: {line"'!r}'"')
        j = i + 1
        old_count = new_count = 0
        while j < len(lines) and not lines[j].startswith(('@@ ', 'diff --git ')):
            body = lines[j]
            if body.startswith(' '):
                old_count += 1
                new_count += 1
            elif body.startswith('-') and not body.startswith('--- '):
                old_count += 1
            elif body.startswith('+') and not body.startswith('+++ '):
                new_count += 1
            elif body.startswith('\\\\'):
                pass
            else:
                raise SystemExit(f'unexpected hunk line: {body"'!r}'"')
            j += 1
        start_old, start_new, suffix = match.groups()
        result.append(f'@@ -{start_old},{old_count} +{start_new},{new_count} @@{suffix}\\n')
        result.extend(lines[i + 1:j])
        i = j
    else:
        result.append(line)
        i += 1
path.write_text(''.join(result))
PY
